value.signature: fn decode_transaction (bytes : & [u8] , limits : Limits) -> Result < Transaction , Refusal >

review.body: { let result = (| | { let mut reader = Reader :: new (bytes , limits) ? ; reader . transaction () ? ; if reader . pos != bytes . len () { return Err (Refusal :: Trailing) ; } let tx : elements :: Transaction = elements :: encoding :: decode_from_slice (bytes) . map_err (| _ | Refusal :: Codec) ? ; Ok (project (tx)) }) () ; if result . is_err () { tracing :: info ! (outcome = "refusal") ; } result }
review.item_premise: An allocation-free framing pass precedes the maintained codec. Complete consumption is required, and every error publishes refusal.
